value_axis: Ambient coordinate zero; key-only frame has D-1 rows and is prepended with a zero row when interpreted in ambient space.
model: q uniform on S^(d-1), all candidate records independent N(0,I_D), feasible target frame from Gaussian QR with positive diagonal. First argmax z_i^T Pq; later argmax z_i^T PP^T z_previous, without query normalization. Values are signs of independent raw Gaussian value coordinates.
noise: Per-example zeta and xi are independent signs with P(+1)=0.9 and independent of all inputs. Final readouts share zeta for pairing; the auxiliary label is exactly xi times the selected FIRST VALUE SIGN. Selected indices are never learner targets.

moments.statistic: R1=sum_i g_i(z_i-zbar). Final mean averages Y*partial_1 G(b)*R1*q^T, b_h=mean_i sign(g_hi). Auxiliary mean averages noisy first VALUE*R1*q^T. No index observation is used.
moments.derivative_mass: parity:2^(1-k); majority product:(10/13)*(13/32)^(k/3); terminal first-position mass is zero at k>1 and is recorded only as a null diagnostic, not normalized or polar-completed into a learner.
moments.exact_mse: For s=lambda*c0*a2/d and final kappa, E||M/(s*kappa)-P||F^2/d=(D-1)/(n*d*s^2*kappa)-1/n. Auxiliary substitutes s=mu*c0*a2/d and kappa=1. c0=sqrt(2/pi),a2=1/sqrt(pi).
moments.projection: Thin SVD polar; retain all singular values/ranks, including rank-deficient target-independent completions. Frame error retains initial-query orientation; no Procrustes alignment.
